svg.title: Suragu — Blood of the Caldera. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Lava classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Magma Vein forks into Scalding Tide then Pyroclastic Surge, or Clinging Slag then The Mountain Wakes. Cooling Crust forks into Igneous Shell then Heart of the Caldera, or Molten Draught then Unquenchable Furnace. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Lava jutsu.

Magma Vein answers \"How do I win offensively: empower my own Lava strikes or set the enemy burning?\": Pyroclastic Surge builds Lava Wave's self buff to 43% and pays off with +2 Damage (Infernal Stream 40 \u2192 42, Magma Slayer 45 \u2192 47; no tier crossing), while The Mountain Wakes takes Eruption Strike's Afterburn to 45%, which every later non-pierce hit on the target feeds. Cooling Crust answers \"How do I stay standing in a long fight: harden the crust or drink the flow?\": Heart of the Caldera makes Lava Wave a 40% mitigation tile with a buff rider, and Unquenchable Furnace takes Infernal Stream's Lifesteal to the +5% ceiling with a light mitigation rider. Others cost 60 AP, Blow 40. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Lava jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
The Mountain Wakes path + Scalding Tide
Heart of the Caldera path + Magma Vein
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn · LS: Lifesteal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SURAGU KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Lava classification / forked tree
